parameters.jsCode:
const cronData = items[0].json;

if (cronData.error) {
  return [{ json: { error: cronData.error } }];
}

// Transform extracted data to ParsedNutrition format
const ParsedNutrition = {
  name: cronData.name || 'Cronometer Food',
  energy_kcal: cronData.macros?.energy_kcal || 0,
  energy_kj: cronData.macros?.energy_kj || 0,
  protein_g: cronData.macros?.protein_g || 0,
  carbs_g: cronData.macros?.carbs_g || 0,
  fat_g: cronData.macros?.fat_g || 0,
  fiber_g: 0,
  sugar_g: 0,
  sodium_mg: 0,
  potassium_mg: 0,
  calcium_mg: 0,
  iron_mg: 0,
  magnesium_mg: 0,
  phosphorus_mg: 0,
  zinc_mg: 0,
  copper_mg: 0,
  manganese_mg: 0,
  selenium_mcg: 0,
  iodine_mcg: 0,
  vitamin_a_mcg: 0,
  vitamin_b6_mg: 0,
  vitamin_b12_mcg: 0,
  vitamin_c_mg: 0,
  vitamin_d_mcg: 0,
  vitamin_e_mg: 0,
  vitamin_k_mcg: 0,
  folate_mcg_dfe: 0,
  niacin_mg_nę: 0,
  riboflavin_b2_mg: 0,
  thiamine_b1_mg: 0,
  pantothenic_acid_mg: 0,
  choline_mg: 0,
  // Amino acids
  alanine_g: 0,
  arginine_g: 0,
  aspartic_acid_g: 0,
  cysteine_g: 0,
  glutamic_acid_g: 0,
  glycine_g: 0,
  histidine_g: 0,
  isoleucine_g: 0,
  leucine_g: 0,
  lysine_g: 0,
  methionine_g: 0,
  phenylalanine_g: 0,
  proline_g: 0,
  serine_g: 0,
  threonine_g: 0,
  tryptophan_g: 0,
  tyrosine_g: 0,
  valine_g: 0,
  // Additional nutrients
  cholesterol_mg: 0,
  saturated_fat_g: 0,
  monounsaturated_fat_g: 0,
  polyunsaturated_fat_g: 0,
  trans_fat_g: 0,
  servings: cronData.servings || []
};

// Map micronutrients from cronData.micros
if (cronData.micros && typeof cronData.micros === 'object') {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(cronData.micros)) {
    if (ParsedNutrition.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
      ParsedNutrition[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

console.log('✓ Formatted to ParsedNutrition:', ParsedNutrition.name);

return [{ json: ParsedNutrition }];
